title: {{NAME}} and the Most Magical Match
moral: Being a good sport means cheering for everyone, not just yourself.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a vivid magenta superhero cape with a gold star, a sky blue soccer jersey with a silver unicorn horn logo, white shorts, and blue-and-gold soccer boots — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} flew down to a glowing soccer stadium.
The grass sparkled in all the colours of the rainbow.
Superheroes in coloured capes filled the stands.
Unicorns in tiny soccer boots trotted on the field.
{{NAME}} had never seen a match like this.

pages.content:
A golden unicorn trotted to {{NAME}}.
"Will you be our team captain?" it asked.
{{NAME}}'s mouth fell open wide.
"Me? Captain?" he said.
"Yes," said the unicorn. "We trust you."

{{NAME}} flew across the field.

The unicorn dribbled past three players.
The crowd went wild!

The other team scored a goal.
{{NAME}} could have felt angry.
But he clapped instead.
"Good kick," he said.
The unicorn looked at {{NAME}} and smiled wide.

pages.content:
{{NAME}}'s team scored the last goal and won.
But he ran to shake hands with everyone.
The superheroes and unicorns cheered for him.
Not for winning, but for being kind.
{{NAME}} sat on the rainbow grass, tired and happy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. That was the best match ever.
I wonder what adventure the golden unicorn has for you next time.
